resources.string: Places to see, eat, shop and stay around where you are, from Google Maps. Location is asked for here, only while you use this screen.
Approximate location is enough. You can share your precise location if you like; we never track you in the background for this screen.
Near me needs your approximate location to find places around you. You can allow it in Settings.
Finding places near you… This can take a few seconds.
Turn on location in your phone’s settings, then try again.
Your phone didn’t return a position. Step outside or wait a moment, then try again.
We don’t know a town or city near you yet.
We couldn’t find places near you. Try again.
You’re offline. Check your connection and try again.
Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
AI limit reached for this month — try again on the 1st.
AI features are switched off on this server right now.
Live map results aren’t available on this server.
We found where you are but no places to show right now. Try again later.
Nothing found nearby for this one.
No app on this phone can open maps.

If you turn on nearby suggestions in Settings, we may remind you to open Near me during a trip. For that we keep only a rough area (about 5 km) from your last visit here, for 24 hours; nothing is looked up in the background.
